claims.title: Bayesian Boolean K3 excess coding cost equals summed posterior minority mass
claims.scope: finite Boolean model families with a declared rational prior, deterministic coordinate observations, and complete-confusion K3 coding using only two source symbols
assumptions: the model-informed oracle knows the model identity
the Bayesian controller minimizes expected prefix length under the declared prior
observations reveal the declared coordinate subset exactly
nonclaims: the prior is not empirically inferred by this theorem
the result is not evidence for simulation

claims.title: Uniform-prior Bayesian Boolean gap is one half times one minus expected absolute conditional bias
claims.scope: uniform Boolean cube prior with g=(-1)^f and exact coordinate observations
assumptions: the Boolean source uses symbols zero and one
conditional expectations are taken under the uniform prior
nonclaims: the same unweighted formula is not asserted for arbitrary priors

claims.title: Bayesian Boolean experiment value is monotone under coordinate refinement
claims.scope: the declared Bayesian Boolean experiment model
assumptions: additional observations refine the existing sigma-field without changing the prior or decision loss

claims.title: Leave-one-coordinate Bayesian gap equals one half of Boolean influence under the uniform prior
claims.scope: uniform Boolean cube prior after observing every coordinate except one
assumptions: influence is the uniform probability that flipping the omitted coordinate changes f
nonclaims: the identity uses the uniform cube measure

claims.title: The Boolean-lattice Möbius transform exactly reconstructs Bayesian experiment value
claims.scope: finite coordinate-subset value functions returned by the Bayesian Boolean geometry solver
assumptions: every coordinate subset is included exactly once
nonclaims: Möbius coefficients are not automatically causal effects

claims.title: Uniform three-bit parity keeps Bayesian gap one half until all three bits are observed
claims.scope: three-bit parity under the uniform prior
nonclaims: the value one half is specific to the symmetric prior

claims.title: Uniform three-bit AND has the same top-order interaction support as parity but one-quarter the Bayesian gap magnitude
claims.scope: three-bit AND versus parity under the uniform prior
assumptions: the same K3 coding criterion is used
nonclaims: matching interaction support does not imply matching truth-table geometry

claims.title: Uniform three-bit majority spreads Bayesian experiment interaction across first, second, and third orders
claims.scope: three-bit majority under the uniform prior
nonclaims: the coefficient pattern is specific to this finite example

claims.title: Bounded exact Bayesian Boolean experiment audit
claims.scope: parity, AND, majority, skewed-prior, influence, monotonicity, and Möbius inversion tests
assumptions: all probabilities use exact rational arithmetic
nonclaims: bounded tests are not a scalability theorem
CI success is not evidence for simulation
